URL Parser

gxsURL parses URLs into gxsURLInfo and encodes or decodes URL text.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Parse() splits scheme://user:passwd@host:port/path?query#fragment. IPv6 literal hosts are written in brackets ([2001:db8::1]:8443) and stored without them. When no port is given the scheme's default port is used (https 443, ftps 990, smtps 465, pop3s 995 and others).

gxsURLInfo u;
if(gxsURL::Parse("https://user:pw@[::1]:8443/data?id=5", u))
  std::cout << u.host << " " << u.port << " " << u.PathAndQuery() << "\n";
